activity_summary: You went to the Theatre for the two o'clock Shrew, though the bill did not mark you to play. At the tiring-house door the gatherer brought the day's other news: the Queen has come up suddenly to Whitehall, and nobody can say why. Heminges said a court does not move in December for nothing. Dick caught your eye, and nobody spoke of a hall. You said you would hear the first act from the door and be home before the candle.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the reason would come by breakfast, and that he was not in the play.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Asked why, and said Christmas is set down for Richmond.

entities.context: Looked at William and said only that the Shrew begins at two.
